newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian killed in West Bank blast.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian killed in West Bank blast.

text.p: A Palestinian man was killed on Monday in an explosion near the town of Nablus in the West Bank, hospital and Israeli military sources said.

An official at Nablus's Rafidia hospital said Abdel Jawad Abdullah, 48, died of injuries following the blast at a blacksmith's in Huwwara village south of the town. The blacksmith, Youssef Hadawi, was injured in the explosion.
The area is under Palestinian civilian rule but remains under Israeli security control.

The military sources said Israeli soldiers had discovered five "improvised charges" in Huwwara in searches conducted after the blast, raising media speculation the men may have been trying to assemble bombs for use against Israeli targets.
Palestinians said the men did not know they were handling explosives.
A relative of Hadawi's said Abdullah, a vegetable salesman, had found some large pieces of metal and taken them to the blacksmith's to have them turned into weights for a scale.
The relative said the metal was apparently an old shell or explosive which exploded in the workshop.
Israel has been on high alert since a double suicide bombing in a market in Jerusalem last month. Sixteen people, including the two Arab bombers, were killed.
